chapter: Edgar Blanchard, Danny White and spot jobbing
title: The party record and the Dream Room audience
summary: The band made a comedy party record he never received a copy of, and the Dream Room in the French Quarter catered to white tourists.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah. We made a record, man, and I never did. We made a party record. I didn't even get a copy. Wait, this group here? This group here, we made a party record. Hang Down Your Head, Tom Dooley. For who? I don't know. I don't remember. I remember we made a party record, man. It was very, and it had a sitcom thing on it, a comedy thing about it. And Edgar was very humorous on that record, man. People come from the Blue Room to come hear
us do this type of thing. But Dream Room was mostly in the French
quarters. It was in the French quarters.
It was in the quarters, but I'm saying it's mostly whites went to see you.
